ideas.mechanism: noncommuting fermionic density operators drive a common oscillator along an approximately closed trajectory; net bus displacement cancels while geometric holonomy generates a sum of density squares
ideas.question: Can a jointly closed bus trajectory generate the desired chemical interaction without decomposing into independent one-density geometric gates?
ideas.unresolved_core: non-Abelian bus closure, operator-valued residual displacement, useful fermionic subclass

ideas.mechanism: tile the determinant transition graph by occupation-dependent short excitation cycles; accept mutually agreed disjoint cells, propagate within cells, place every remaining edge in a residual layer
ideas.question: Can overlapping-orbital excitation cycles be organized coherently using a compact occupation rule rather than an exponential determinant table or ordinary one-sparse edge coloring?
ideas.unresolved_core: reversible cell consistency/coverage and a class with chemically relevant coherent multi-edge cells

ideas.mechanism: choose finite-step defects tangent to an isospectral orbit using a processor and fermionic operator identities
ideas.question: Is this more than known processed/corrected product formulas and eigenstate commutator identities?
ideas.unresolved_core: possible complete reduction to existing corrected PF and stopped H1

ideas.mechanism: infer absolute energy by integrating derivatives along an anchored Hamiltonian path
ideas.question: Does integrability of energy derivatives supply a different information acquisition rule?
ideas.unresolved_core: likely Hellmann-Feynman/adiabatic connection; state and gap acquisition costs

ideas.mechanism: replace exponentials by all-pass rational/Cayley transforms through ancillary scattering
ideas.question: Can a physical scattering construction supply the resolvent without block embedding or assuming evolution by the whole H?
ideas.unresolved_core: no explicit allowed resolver; known QSP/walk realization may violate D1

ideas.mechanism: use eigenstate stationary commutators as control variates for energy measurement
ideas.question: Is the construction different from known fermionic constraints and measurement optimization?
ideas.unresolved_core: likely known control variates; no free RDM/covariance

ideas.mechanism: lift term generators into an auxiliary code so finite-step defects have a correctable syndrome while the target phase is logical
ideas.question: Can explicit lifted generators and deterministic recovery satisfy this without a projected-H block implementation?
ideas.unresolved_core: lift and recovery not specified; code-preserving generators keep commutators logical

ideas.mechanism: read absolute electronic energy from a self-synchronizing autonomous clock
ideas.question: What explicit coupling transfers a signed absolute energy into a clock frequency without an added energy oracle?
